summary.headline: $1.2M annual savings across 10 categories
summary.narrative: Treya Partners achieved $1.2M in annual savings for APDerm by addressing over 10 spend categories. The project leveraged a mix of RFPs, direct negotiations, and GPO contracts, retaining incumbent suppliers where possible to ensure minimal disruption.

impact.operational_improvements: Improved procurement processes and leveraged enterprise-wide purchasing power.

evidence.quote: Total project savings of $1.2M or 19% on $6.3M in baseline spend over 2 Phases.

case_study_packaging.headline: $1.2M run-rate savings across 10 categories
case_study_packaging.client_problem_statement: APDerm faced increasing costs, fragmented spend, and lacked leveraged purchasing power across its multiple locations.
approach_summary: Conducted comprehensive spend analysis across 10 categories.
Ran RFP processes and direct negotiations with incumbent suppliers.
Leveraged GPO contracts for commoditized categories.
Collaborated closely with APDerm stakeholders to ensure business needs were met.
case_study_packaging.value_delivered_blurb: Treya Partners delivered over $1.2M in annualized savings for APDerm by optimizing procurement processes and leveraging enterprise-wide purchasing power.

extraction_notes: Some projected savings estimates from the Assessment documents were not directly found in the Agreement.
Confidence levels vary depending on document type and recency.
Employee Benefit savings are still in progress and estimates may change.
The project involved numerous categories; all identified have been included.
